children: Gravity (by Galxe) has launched Fast Withdraw on the official Gravity bridge, enabling $G transfers from Gravity Alpha Mainnet to Ethereum in roughly ten minutes instead of the previous seven-day waiting period. The feature applies only to new transfers, while pending withdrawals continue to follow the original process.

Shortening withdrawal settlement from seven days to about ten minutes changes how quickly liquidity can move between Gravity and Ethereum. The team attributed a 30-40% cross-exchange price dislocation in $G to bridging constraints, so near-instant exits give investors a direct mechanism for arbitrage and help unify liquidity across venues. The scope limitation is narrow but worth noting: transfers submitted before the launch still settle under the original seven-day process, so older pending withdrawals see no change.
